method.scope: Only the six durable request directories of cases in this pilot: Task extraction, annotation, initial review, isolated Task revision, annotation repair/reannotation, and final review. Connectivity diagnostics are excluded.
method.logical_calls: One on-disk call.json per actual request. Corrections are distinct calls; accepted-response replay is not a call.
method.tokens: Sum HTTP attempt usage exactly once; top-level transport usage repeats the last attempt and is excluded. Missing usage is unknown, never zero.
method.cache: API-reported cache-hit/miss/reasoning/detail fields are breakdowns, not extra tokens; never add them to total_tokens.
method.prompt_size: Character and UTF-8 byte counts use each actual prompt.txt once per logical request, with a content-hash deduplication subtotal. HTTP retries do not create prompts. These are sizes, not token estimates.
method.time: Call wall, transport call, and HTTP elapsed are nested measures and must not be added together. Per-case clocks include local stage work. Initial terminal times are frozen before replay.
method.overall_start: An explicit process start can be supplied once; otherwise use the earliest recorded call. Preparation is excluded. Never infer a process clock from measurement time.
method.not_semantics: Usage and completion metrics do not validate sensitivity, demand, or DOE conclusions.

online_timing.basis: explicit online process start or earliest recorded call to initially observed completed pilot summary.json mtime
